sources.entry: Unread - RSS reader with beautiful typography that supports Feedbin, Feedly and so on. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/unread-an-rss-reader/id1363637349?platform=mac)

summary.name: Unread
summary.one_liner: Unread is an RSS reader app with clean typography and multiple color themes, available for Mac, iPhone, and iPad.
use_cases: reading news and blog feeds on Mac and iPhone
syncing feed subscriptions across Apple devices
reading full articles from summary-only feeds
reading paywalled sites with a logged-in session
monitoring unread counts on home screen widgets
summary.what_it_does: Unread is an RSS reader that displays feeds with a focus on typography and selectable light and dark color themes. It can sync through Unread Cloud, Feedbin, Feedly, NewsBlur, or self-hosted feed sync systems. When a feed only contains summaries, it retrieves and displays the full webpage text, and it caches text and images for offline reading. Share extensions let users subscribe to feeds or save webpages from Safari, Chrome, Firefox, and other browsers. It also offers home screen widgets, search across article lists, and full text for link articles that quote another article.
notable: Full webpage text retrieved for summary-only feeds, with offline caching
Separate light and dark mode color themes
Syncs with Feedbin, Feedly, NewsBlur and self-hosted services
Sends articles to many read-later and bookmarking services
caveats: Unread Premium is a paid subscription that adds article actions for email/iMessage, custom shortcuts on articles, caching, custom app icons, widget customization, and priority support
Some features such as caching and widget customization are listed under Premium rather than the free app
